bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
branch="fix/gay-video-pin-stale-message-repair-20261123"
git fetch --no-tags origin "$branch"
head="$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)"
test "$head" = "e957518b3d3dea5959e3d86db1d4298b99a3bac2"
worktree="$PWD/.worktrees/gay-video-stale-repair-20261123"
if test ! -d "$worktree"; then mkdir -p "$PWD/.worktrees"; git worktree add --detach "$worktree" "$head"; fi
git -C "$worktree" checkout --detach "$head"
test -z "$(git -C "$worktree" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
base="$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}')"
docker image inspect "$base" >/dev/null
docker tag "$base" gace-local-gaybbs-base:20261123
python3 - "$worktree/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" <<'PY'
import pathlib,sys
p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
s=p.read_text().replace("WORKDIR /src\nRUN corepack enable","WORKDIR /src\nUSER root\nRUN corepack enable",1)
pathlib.Path("/tmp/Dockerfile.gaybbs-video-repair").write_text(s)
PY
docker build --network host --pull=false --build-arg "NODE_IMAGE=gace-local-gaybbs-base:20261123" -t gace-gaybbs-gay-stale-repair:20261123 -f /tmp/Dockerfile.gaybbs-video-repair "$worktree" >/tmp/video-two-topic-build.log 2>&1 || { tail -n 80 /tmp/video-two-topic-build.log >&2; exit 66; }
test -n "$(docker image inspect gace-gaybbs-gay-stale-repair:20261123 --format '{{.Id}}')"
container="$(docker create gace-gaybbs-gay-stale-repair:20261123)"
stage="$(mktemp /tmp/gace-gay-only-XXXXXX.mjs)"
trap 'docker rm "$container" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -f "$stage"' EXIT
docker cp "$container:/app/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs" "$stage"
docker exec -i deploy-gaybbs-1 node --check --input-type=module - < "$stage"
docker exec -i -e VIDEO_TWO_TOPIC_ENTRY_APPLY=disabled -e VIDEO_TWO_TOPIC_RECOVER_GAY_ONLY=enabled deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs --input-type=module - < "$stage" >/tmp/video-gay-recovery-dryrun.out 2>/tmp/video-gay-recovery-dryrun.err
echo VIDEO_GAY_ONLY_RECOVERY_PREFLIGHT=PASS
